permissions.description: Create or modify explicitly scoped application data.
Read files within a separately defined filesystem scope.
Create, modify, or delete files within a separately defined filesystem scope.
Connect to explicitly listed network destinations.
Launch a process within a separately qualified execution boundary.
Access a declared hardware device or peripheral.
Use a credential through a dedicated secret-handling interface.
Delegate a bounded task to another identified agent or service.

note: These labels are design metadata. The current policy helper does not enforce operating-system or network boundaries.
